subject: loop
description: Three independent tickets in three nested packages, worked by a loop two lanes at a time. Each ticket's verifier is a hidden test the agent never sees.

tickets.title: Add slugify to the text package
tickets.description: Export `slugify(text)` from packages/text/src/slug.js. Lowercase, trim, replace runs of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, and strip leading and trailing hyphens.
acceptanceCriteria: The package's own tests pass with `node --test`

tickets.title: Add clamp to the math package
tickets.description: Export `clamp(value, min, max)` from packages/math/src/clamp.js. Throw a RangeError when min is greater than max.
acceptanceCriteria: The package's own tests pass with `node --test`

tickets.title: Add chunk to the list package
tickets.description: Export `chunk(items, size)` from packages/list/src/chunk.js, splitting an array into arrays of at most `size` items. Throw a RangeError for a size below 1.
acceptanceCriteria: The package's own tests pass with `node --test`
